observations: body L2-L12: the figure stands at the left of lines 2 to 12, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the ecliptic AHDB, printed a little wider than high, as an ellipse about its pole F; the straight lines FB, FA and FC′ (through M, M′ and C) and the chords BA, GE and GA; the great circle DH through G and E and the great circle through G and A as arcs, each below its chord; the bold italic letters and the italic word ecliptica along the circle.
body L3-L4: Schiaparelli's name is letter-spaced and divided between the lines.

body L14-L18: the proportion and the rule are right: in the projection FG = FE = R cos β and FB = FA = R, GM and BC are the halves of the chords GE and BA, and the chord between the two stars, parallel to the ecliptic, keeps its length; so R sin (GE/2) : R sin ((L − L′)/2) = R cos β : R.
body L16, L18, L30: the minus signs are printed as long dashes (10.1 to 10.4 pt); they are set as minus signs.
body L19, L22, L27: the dashes of «al–Battānī», «1–2», «39–40» and «11–13» are long dashes (5.4 to 5.5 pt).
body L25-L26: the letter-spaced name of al-Battānī is divided between the lines, its long dash printed at the end of L25 (5.5 pt) and again at the head of L26 (5.8 pt).
body L28: in the head, the dash after «b)» measures 10.0 pt and the dash of «1–12» 5.4 pt; transcribed as a dash and a long dash.

body L34: the printed formula has 2 GB². Ptolemy's theorem in the symmetric quadrilateral GEAB, GA × EB = GE × BA + EA × GB with EB = GA and EA = GB, gives GA² = GB² + GE × BA (with R = 1, β = 30° and L − L′ = 60°: GA² = 1.134, GB² = 0.268, GE × BA = 0.866), as rule (α) of the next page, which adds the square of the third side once. The printed form is kept. The exponent of GA is printed broken.
notes_left L6: the hyphen of «Inter-» is printed short (1.9 pt).
notes_right L4: the Arabic letters are those of al-Battānī's figure for F, M, G, C and B.
notes_right L6: the signature 26 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
